visualCharacteristics.purpose: Tabular data, or a bordered callout box when the table has a single cell
visualCharacteristics.layout: Multi-cell: full-width table, first row as column headers, horizontal scroll on narrow screens. Single cell: bordered box holding the cell content (bold heading paragraph + text)

contentPattern.structure: one block row per table row, one cell per column; the first row is the header unless the no-header class is set. A single-cell block renders as a callout
contentPattern.example: Single cell: bold 'The broader impact of our support' paragraph followed by a text paragraph with a BoardSource link

notes: 1 blog-article story uses a single-cell Table as a callout

reuseGuidance: Use 'Table' for real rows and columns. For a boxed aside, author a single-cell Table: the content renders inside a bordered box.
